data.name: _LanguageName
data.comment: The name of this file's language, written in that language. Shown in Settings.

data.name: Common_Cancel
data.comment: A button that closes a dialog and changes nothing.

data.name: Common_Close
data.comment: A button or menu item that closes a window, a panel or a tab.

data.name: Common_Save
data.comment: A button that saves what was edited.

data.name: Common_Delete
data.comment: A button or menu item that deletes the selected thing.

data.name: Common_Apply
data.comment: A button that applies what was set in a dialog or panel.

data.name: Common_Refresh
data.comment: A button that reads the shown information again from the server.

data.name: Common_Copy
data.comment: A button or menu item that copies to the clipboard.

data.name: Common_Stop
data.comment: A button that stops a running operation.

data.name: Common_Discard
data.comment: A button that throws away unsaved or staged changes.

data.name: Common_Remove
data.comment: A button that removes an item from a list.

data.name: Common_Add
data.comment: A button that adds an item.

data.name: Common_Rename
data.comment: A button that renames an item.

data.name: Common_Commit
data.comment: A button that commits a transaction or staged changes to the database (a database COMMIT).

data.name: Common_Browse
data.comment: A button that opens a file or folder chooser.

data.name: Common_Retry
data.comment: A button that tries a failed operation again.

data.name: Common_Open
data.comment: A button that opens the selected item.

data.name: Framework_Cut
data.comment: The right-click menu of every text box.

data.name: Framework_Copy
data.comment: The right-click menu of every text box.

data.name: Framework_Paste
data.comment: The right-click menu of every text box.

data.name: Framework_Day
data.comment: A date picker's day part.

data.name: Framework_Month
data.comment: A date picker's month part.

data.name: Framework_Year
data.comment: A date picker's year part.

data.name: Framework_Hour
data.comment: A time picker's hour part.

data.name: Framework_Minute
data.comment: A time picker's minute part.

data.name: Framework_Second
data.comment: A time picker's second part.

data.name: About_Tagline
data.value: Un client PostgreSQL rapide et open source

data.name: About_Version
data.comment: About box: under the name. {version} is the release number, such as 1.4.0.

data.name: About_License
data.comment: About box: the license line when the copyright text is unknown.

data.name: About_CopyrightLicense
data.comment: About box: copyright and license on one line. {copyright} is the copyright notice, such as "Copyright (c) 2026 Name".

data.name: About_RateInStore
data.value: Noter pgNimbus dans le Microsoft Store
data.comment: About box: link shown only in the Microsoft Store version.

data.name: Settings_LanguageSection
data.comment: Settings, General tab: section header. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_Language
data.comment: Settings, General tab: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_LanguageHint
data.value: Menus, boîtes de dialogue et messages. Le SQL, les messages du serveur et vos données restent inchangés, et un texte sans traduction s'affiche en anglais.
data.comment: Settings, General tab: under the Language setting.

data.name: Settings_LanguageSystem
data.comment: Settings, General tab, and the connection dialog's language menu: the first choice in the Language list, which follows the operating system. {language} is that language's name in itself, such as English or 简体中文.

data.name: Settings_TabGeneral
data.comment: Settings: name of the first tab.

data.name: Settings_TabAppearance
data.comment: Settings: name of the second tab.

data.name: Settings_TabEditor
data.comment: Settings: name of the third tab.

data.name: Settings_TabData
data.comment: Settings: name of the fourth tab.

data.name: Settings_StartupSection
data.comment: Settings, General tab: section heading. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_AutoConnect
data.value: Ouvrir la dernière connexion au démarrage
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Startup: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_AutoConnectHint
data.value: Se connecte directement à la dernière connexion utilisée au lieu d'attendre dans la boîte de connexion. Elle reste à un « Changer de connexion » de distance, et un échec ramène à la boîte avec l'erreur.
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Startup: hint under the setting. "Switch connection" is the name of a menu command.

data.name: Settings_KeyboardSection
data.comment: Settings, General tab: section heading. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_ShortcutModifier
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Keyboard: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_ShortcutModifierHint
data.value: Auto utilise Cmd sur macOS et Ctrl ailleurs. S'applique tout de suite aux raccourcis, à la palette de commandes et à l'aide-mémoire.
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Keyboard: hint under the setting. Cmd and Ctrl are key names and stay as they are.

data.name: Settings_ModifierAuto
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Keyboard: a choice in the shortcut modifier list (pick Cmd or Ctrl by platform).

data.name: Settings_HistorySection
data.comment: Settings, General tab: section heading. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_RecordHistory
data.comment: Settings, General tab, History: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_RecordHistoryHint
data.value: Conserve le texte de chaque requête exécutée dans un fichier local non chiffré. Les mots de passe des instructions sont masqués.
data.comment: Settings, General tab, History: hint under the setting.

data.name: Settings_Theme
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_ThemeHint
data.value: Système suit le réglage clair/sombre de l'OS
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: hint under Theme.

data.name: Settings_ThemeSystem
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: a choice in the Theme list, following the operating system's light or dark setting.

data.name: Settings_ThemeLight
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: a choice in the Theme list.

data.name: Settings_ThemeDark
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: a choice in the Theme list.

data.name: Settings_InterfaceFont
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_InterfaceFontHint
data.value: Système correspond à San Francisco sur macOS, Segoe UI sur Windows et à la police du bureau sous Linux. Inter est identique partout.
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: hint under Interface font. San Francisco, Segoe UI and Inter are font names and stay as they are; System is the first choice of the list.

data.name: Settings_FontSystem
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: a choice in the Interface font list, the operating system's own font.

data.name: Settings_CodeFont
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_CodeFontHint
data.value: Pour l'éditeur SQL, les valeurs, les plans et tous les autres endroits qui affichent du code. Liste les polices à chasse fixe installées sur cet ordinateur.
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: hint under Code font.

data.name: Settings_CodeFontBuiltIn
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the first choice in the Code font list, the font that ships with pgNimbus. JetBrains Mono is a font name and stays as it is.

data.name: Settings_EditorFontSize
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_EditorFontSizeHint
data.value: La taille de départ de chaque éditeur SQL, à laquelle {gesture} revient. Le zoom ne change que l'éditeur courant.
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: hint under Editor font size. {gesture} is the keyboard shortcut that resets the zoom, such as Ctrl+0 or ⌘0; it is built by the app and not translated.

data.name: Settings_ShowSizes
data.value: Afficher la taille des tables dans l'arborescence
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: the setting's name (a switch). A relation is a table or materialized view.

data.name: Settings_ShowSizesHint
data.value: Ajoute la taille sur disque de chaque table et vue matérialisée (heap + index + TOAST) en grisé à côté de son nom
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: hint under Show relation sizes. Heap and TOAST are PostgreSQL storage terms.

data.name: Settings_CompletionSection
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab: section heading. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_AutoAlias
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_AutoAliasHint
data.value: Accepter une table après FROM/JOIN insère aussi un alias court (orders → orders o)
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: hint under the setting. FROM and JOIN are SQL keywords; the example is SQL.

data.name: Settings_KeywordCase
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: the setting's name.

data.name: Settings_KeywordCaseHint
data.value: Comment s'écrivent les mots-clés acceptés. Selon la saisie suit ce que vous avez commencé : tr donne true, SEL donne SELECT.
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: hint under Keyword case. "As typed" is the first choice of the list; tr/true and SEL/SELECT are typing examples and stay as they are.

data.name: Settings_KeywordCaseAsTyped
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab: a choice in the Keyword case list; keywords follow the case the user started typing in.

data.name: Settings_KeywordCaseUpper
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab: a choice in the Keyword case list; keywords are written in capitals. Write it in capitals if your language has them.

data.name: Settings_KeywordCaseLower
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab: a choice in the Keyword case list; keywords are written in small letters.

data.name: Settings_AlwaysQualify
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_AlwaysQualifyHint
data.value: Désactivé, une table s'insère seule quand le search_path la trouve (customers), et avec son schéma sinon (saas.users). Activé, chaque table s'insère avec son schéma.
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: hint under the setting. search_path is a PostgreSQL setting; customers and saas.users are examples and stay as they are.

data.name: Settings_EnterAccepts
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_EnterAcceptsHint
data.value: Activé, Enter prend la suggestion choisie ou commencée, et insère un saut de ligne sinon. Désactivé, seule Tab accepte et Enter termine toujours la ligne.
data.comment: Settings, Editor tab, Completion: hint under the setting. Enter and Tab are key names.

data.name: Settings_SafeMode
data.comment: Settings, Data tab: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_SafeModeHint
data.value: Les modifications et suppressions de la grille et les insertions « Ajouter une ligne » sont mises en attente et surlignées ; relisez le SQL généré, puis validez le tout en une transaction, ou abandonnez
data.comment: Settings, Data tab: hint under Safe mode.

data.name: Settings_FilterBar
data.value: Toujours afficher la barre de filtres en navigation
data.comment: Settings, Data tab: the setting's name (a switch).

data.name: Settings_FilterBarHint
data.value: Garde la ligne de filtres au-dessus de la grille même sans condition, pour que + Filtre soit toujours à portée. Désactivée, elle apparaît dès qu'une condition (ou un WHERE saisi) filtre les lignes. Aussi basculée par l'entonnoir de la barre d'état.
data.comment: Settings, Data tab: hint under the setting. "+ Filter" is the name of a button; WHERE is the SQL keyword.

data.name: Settings_BackupSection
data.comment: Settings, Data tab: section heading. Written in capitals in English; write it as your language writes a heading.

data.name: Settings_PgTools
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: the card's name.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsHint
data.value: pg_dump et pg_restore créent et restaurent les sauvegardes. pgNimbus les trouve là où PostgreSQL, pgAdmin, Postgres.app et Homebrew les installent.
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: hint under the card's name. pg_dump, pg_restore, pgAdmin, Postgres.app and Homebrew are program names.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsChooseFolder
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: button that opens a folder picker.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsChooseFolderTip
data.value: Choisir le dossier qui contient pg_dump et pg_restore
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: tooltip of the Choose Folder button.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsLookAgain
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: button that searches for the programs again.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsAutomatic
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: button that goes back to searching automatically.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsAutomaticTip
data.value: Oublier le dossier et chercher à nouveau
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: tooltip of the Automatic button.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsLooking
data.comment: Status line while the search runs, in Settings and in the Backup and Restore windows. {tool} is the program name: pg_dump or pg_restore.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsFromFolder
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: line under the card when the user picked a folder. {folder} is a folder path.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsFoundAutomatically
data.comment: Settings, Data tab, Backup: line under the card when the programs were found without the user choosing a folder.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsNeeds
data.comment: Heading of the Backup and Restore windows when no usable program is installed. {needed} is a program with a version, such as "pg_dump 17 or newer", or just "pg_restore".

data.name: Settings_PgToolsNeededVersion
data.comment: Part of the heading "pgNimbus needs …": the program and the oldest major version that works. {tool} is pg_dump; {version} is a release such as 17.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsNotFound
data.comment: Status line when the program was not found. {tool} is pg_dump or pg_restore.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsExplainDump
data.value: Les sauvegardes sont faites par pg_dump, le programme de sauvegarde propre à PostgreSQL, fourni avec pg_restore.
data.comment: Backup window, missing-program explanation: first line.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsExplainRestore
data.value: Les sauvegardes sont restaurées par pg_restore, le programme de restauration propre à PostgreSQL, fourni avec pg_dump.
data.comment: Restore window, missing-program explanation: first line.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsFolderProblem
data.value: Les paramètres indiquent à pgNimbus le dossier {folder}, mais {reason}.
data.comment: Missing-program explanation: the folder chosen in Settings holds no usable program. {folder} is a path; {reason} is a clause saying why, such as "it did not start".

data.name: Settings_PgToolsFolderNoProblem
data.value: Les paramètres indiquent à pgNimbus le dossier {folder}.
data.comment: Missing-program explanation: the folder chosen in Settings. {folder} is a path.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsTooOld
data.value: Le {tool} le plus récent sur cet ordinateur est {found}, dans {folder}. Ce serveur exécute PostgreSQL {server}, et {tool} doit être en version {version} ou plus récente pour le sauvegarder.
data.comment: Missing-program explanation: the installed program is older than the server. {tool} is pg_dump; {found} is its version, such as 15.4; {folder} is a path; {server} is the server's version, such as 17.2; {version} is the oldest major release that works, such as 17.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsNoneOnComputer
data.value: pgNimbus n'a pas trouvé {tool} sur cet ordinateur.
data.comment: Missing-program explanation. {tool} is pg_dump or pg_restore.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsOtherProblem
data.value: Il y a un {tool} dans {folder}, mais {reason}.
data.comment: Missing-program explanation: a program was found in a folder but does not work. {tool} is pg_dump or pg_restore; {folder} is a path; {reason} is a clause saying why.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsInstalled
data.comment: Status line of Settings, Backup and Restore: the program that will run. {tool} is pg_dump or pg_restore; {version} is its release, such as 18.6; {folder} is the folder it is in.

data.name: Settings_PgToolsInstalledFrom
data.comment: Status line of Settings, Backup and Restore: the program that will run, with what installed it. {tool} is pg_dump or pg_restore; {version} is its release, such as 18.6; {source} is the product that installed it, such as pgAdmin 4 or Homebrew; {folder} is the folder it is in.

data.name: Settings_FontInter
data.comment: Settings, Appearance tab: a choice in the Interface font list. Inter is a font name: keep it as it is.

data.name: Settings_ModifierCtrl
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Keyboard: a choice in the shortcut modifier list. A key name: keep it as it is, unless your keyboards label the key differently.

data.name: Settings_ModifierCmd
data.comment: Settings, General tab, Keyboard: a choice in the shortcut modifier list. A key name (the Command key of a Mac): keep it as it is, unless your keyboards label the key differently.

data.name: Connection_WindowTitle
data.comment: Connection dialog: the window's title (read by screen readers and the window list).

data.name: Connection_SavedConnections
data.comment: Connection dialog: heading in the title bar, over the list of saved connections.

data.name: Connection_Connect
data.comment: Connection dialog: the primary button that opens the connection, and the first item of a saved connection's right-click menu.

data.name: Connection_MenuDuplicate
data.comment: Connection dialog: right-click menu of a saved connection: makes a copy of it.

data.name: Connection_MenuDelete
data.comment: Connection dialog: right-click menu of a saved connection: deletes it after a confirmation.

data.name: Connection_ReadOnlySession
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the lock icon on a saved connection that opens read-only, and the label of the Read-only switch.

data.name: Connection_NoSavedConnections
data.value: Aucune connexion enregistrée — remplissez le formulaire, elle est conservée ici au fil de la saisie
data.comment: Connection dialog: hint shown over the empty list of saved connections.

data.name: Connection_DeleteConfirm
data.value: Supprimer la connexion enregistrée « {name} » ? Son mot de passe enregistré est supprimé avec elle.
data.comment: Connection dialog: confirmation question before a saved connection is deleted. {name} is the connection's name, such as prod-db.

data.name: Connection_ImportPlaceholder
data.value: Collez une chaîne de connexion (postgres://…, jdbc:…, Key=Value;…, psql …)
data.comment: Connection dialog: placeholder of the box that takes a pasted connection string. Keep the format examples as they are.

data.name: Connection_ImportTooltip
data.value: Collez un URI postgres://, une URL JDBC, une chaîne Npgsql Key=Value, une chaîne de mots-clés libpq ou une ligne de commande psql, et les champs se remplissent seuls
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the paste box.

data.name: Connection_CopyTooltip
data.value: Copier la chaîne de connexion sans le mot de passe. Clic droit pour la copier avec le mot de passe.
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the copy button beside the paste box.

data.name: Connection_CopyWithoutPassword
data.value: Copier sans le mot de passe
data.comment: Connection dialog: menu item of the copy button: copies the connection string with no password.

data.name: Connection_CopyWithPassword
data.value: Copier avec le mot de passe
data.comment: Connection dialog: menu item of the copy button: copies the connection string including the password.

data.name: Connection_CopyWithPasswordTooltip
data.value: Inclut le mot de passe. Exclu de l'historique du presse-papiers quand le système le permet, et effacé du presse-papiers après 30 secondes.
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the Copy With Password menu item.

data.name: Connection_Name
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the connection's name field.

data.name: Connection_AccentColorTooltip
data.value: Couleur d'accent : teinte la fenêtre de cette connexion pour distinguer prod et dev d'un coup d'œil
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the colour swatch button beside the name.

data.name: Connection_NoAccentColor
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the first swatch in the accent colour palette, which clears the colour.

data.name: Connection_HostPort
data.comment: Connection dialog: label over the host and port fields.

data.name: Connection_Database
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the database name field.

data.name: Connection_Username
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the user name field.

data.name: Connection_SslMode
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the TLS mode picker. SSL Mode is the name of the PostgreSQL setting.

data.name: Connection_Recommended
data.comment: Connection dialog: small tag in the SSL mode list beside the mode to use.

data.name: Connection_RootCertificate
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the field naming a certificate authority file to trust.

data.name: Connection_RootCertificatePlaceholder
data.value: Magasin de confiance du système (par défaut)
data.comment: Connection dialog: placeholder of the Root Certificate field when empty.

data.name: Connection_Password
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the database password field.

data.name: Connection_Environment
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the picker that says whether this connection is development, staging or production.

data.name: Connection_ReadOnlyTooltip
data.value: Chaque instruction s'exécute dans une transaction en lecture seule : le serveur refuse INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE et le DDL. C'est une protection contre les erreurs ; pour rendre les écritures impossibles, utilisez un rôle sans droit d'écriture.
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the Read-only session switch. INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE and DDL are SQL words and stay.

data.name: Connection_UseSshTunnel
data.value: Se connecter via un tunnel SSH
data.comment: Connection dialog: label of the switch that sends the connection through an SSH server.

data.name: Connection_SshHostPort
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label over the SSH server's host and port.

data.name: Connection_SshUsername
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label of the SSH user name field.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthMethod
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label of the picker for how to sign in to the SSH server.

data.name: Connection_PrivateKeyPath
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label of the field naming the private key file.

data.name: Connection_PrivateKeyPlaceholder
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: placeholder of the private key path field when empty.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentHint
data.value: Se connecte avec les clés de votre agent SSH : une clé protégée par une phrase secrète n'a rien à saisir ici.
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: shown in place of a key field when the SSH agent method is chosen.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthAgent
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: a choice of the Auth Method picker: sign in with the keys the SSH agent holds.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthKeyFile
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: a choice of the Auth Method picker: sign in with a private key file.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthPassword
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: a choice of the Auth Method picker: sign in with a password.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyPassphrase
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label of the field for the private key's passphrase.

data.name: Connection_SshPassword
data.comment: Connection dialog, SSH block: label of the field for the SSH account's password.

data.name: Connection_Advanced
data.comment: Connection dialog: button that opens or closes the Advanced block (client certificate and timeouts).

data.name: Connection_ClientCertificate
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: label of the field naming the client certificate file (mutual TLS).

data.name: Connection_ClientCertificatePlaceholder
data.value: Aucun (fichier par défaut de libpq, le cas échéant)
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: placeholder of the client certificate field when empty. libpq is the PostgreSQL client library.

data.name: Connection_ClientKey
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: label of the field naming the client certificate's private key file.

data.name: Connection_ClientKeyPlaceholder
data.value: Aucune (phrase secrète non prise en charge)
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: placeholder of the client key field when empty.

data.name: Connection_StatementTimeout
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: label of the field for the longest a statement may run, in seconds.

data.name: Connection_LockTimeout
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: label of the field for the longest a statement may wait for a lock, in seconds.

data.name: Connection_TimeoutNone
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: placeholder of a timeout field when empty (no timeout set).

data.name: Connection_TimeoutHint
data.value: Le serveur annule une instruction qui s'exécute, ou attend un verrou, plus longtemps que cette durée. Vide, les réglages du serveur et du rôle s'appliquent. Les exports, imports et sauvegardes ne sont pas interrompus.
data.comment: Connection dialog, Advanced block: explains the two timeout fields.

data.name: Connection_AccessingPasswordStore
data.value: Accès au magasin de mots de passe…
data.comment: Connection dialog: shown while the operating system's credential store is being read or written.

data.name: Connection_NewConnection
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip and accessible name of the + button under the list that starts a new saved connection.

data.name: Connection_LanguageTip
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip and accessible name of the button at the right end of the title bar that shows the interface language's name and opens the list of languages.

data.name: Connection_Test
data.comment: Connection dialog: button that tries the connection without opening it.

data.name: Connection_TestTooltip
data.value: Vérifier la connexion (et le tunnel SSH, s'il est activé) sans l'ouvrir
data.comment: Connection dialog: tooltip of the Test button.

data.name: Connection_AboutTitle
data.comment: Connection dialog: title of the About panel that opens over the form.

data.name: Connection_PickSshKey
data.comment: Connection dialog: title of the file chooser for the SSH private key.

data.name: Connection_PickRootCertificate
data.comment: Connection dialog: title of the file chooser for the root certificate.

data.name: Connection_PickClientCertificate
data.comment: Connection dialog: title of the file chooser for the client certificate.

data.name: Connection_PickClientKey
data.comment: Connection dialog: title of the file chooser for the client key.

data.name: Connection_FileTypeCertificates
data.comment: Connection dialog: name of the certificate file filter in a file chooser.

data.name: Connection_FileTypeKeys
data.comment: Connection dialog: name of the key file filter in a file chooser.

data.name: Connection_MenuFile
data.comment: Connection dialog: macOS menu bar, the File menu while the connect window is active.

data.name: Connection_MenuCloseWindow
data.comment: Connection dialog: macOS File menu item that closes the window.

data.name: Connection_MenuEdit
data.comment: Connection dialog: macOS menu bar, the Edit menu.

data.name: Connection_MenuWindow
data.comment: Connection dialog: macOS menu bar, the Window menu.

data.name: Connection_EnvironmentHintReadOnly
data.value: La session en lecture seule est activée : les écritures restent désactivées dans toutes les fenêtres.
data.comment: Connection dialog: line under the Environment picker for a production connection that is also read-only.

data.name: Connection_SaveFailed
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line. {message} is the reason, such as Access to the path is denied.

data.name: Connection_CopyName
data.comment: Connection dialog: the name given to a duplicated connection. {name} is the original's name, such as prod-db.

data.name: Connection_TestSucceeded
data.comment: Connection dialog: status line after Test worked. {version} is the server's version, such as 17.2.

data.name: Connection_TestFailed
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line after Test failed. {message} is the reason the server or network gave.

data.name: Connection_Connecting

data.name: Connection_ClientKeyNeedsCertificate
data.value: Une clé client a besoin de son certificat client. Choisissez aussi le fichier du certificat.
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line when a client key is set without a client certificate.

data.name: Connection_ClientCertificateNotFound
data.value: Le fichier du certificat client est introuvable : {path}
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line. {path} is the file path the user entered.

data.name: Connection_ClientKeyNotFound
data.value: Le fichier de la clé client est introuvable : {path}
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line. {path} is the file path the user entered.

data.name: Connection_ClientKeyHasPassphrase
data.value: La clé client est protégée par une phrase secrète, ce que pgNimbus ne prend pas en charge. Enregistrez-en une copie sans phrase secrète (openssl pkey -in client.key -out client-plain.key) et rendez ce fichier lisible par vous seul.
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line. Keep the openssl command as it is.

data.name: Connection_CredentialDeleteFailed
data.value: Un mot de passe enregistré n'a pas pu être supprimé. Déverrouillez le magasin d'identifiants de votre OS et réessayez, ou supprimez l'entrée pgNimbus dans le gestionnaire de mots de passe du système.
data.comment: Connection dialog: warning shown under the form when the operating system refused to delete a stored password.

data.name: Connection_CredentialStorageUnavailable
data.value: Le stockage des mots de passe est indisponible ou la migration n'a pas pu se terminer. Vous pouvez vous connecter avec le mot de passe de cette boîte, mais les changements peuvent ne durer que pour cette session. Vérifiez le magasin d'identifiants de votre OS (Keychain sur macOS ; Secret Service et libsecret-1 sous Linux), puis ressaisissez le mot de passe. Les anciens fichiers d'identifiants sont conservés jusqu'à la vérification de la migration.
data.comment: Connection dialog: warning shown under the form when the operating system's password store cannot be used. Keychain, Secret Service and libsecret-1 are product names.

data.name: Connection_LegacyCredentialLeft_one
data.value: Un ancien fichier d'identifiants non chiffré n'a pas pu être déplacé vers le magasin d'identifiants de votre OS et se trouve toujours sur le disque. Ouvrez la connexion concernée et enregistrez à nouveau son mot de passe pour le supprimer.
data.comment: Connection dialog: warning under the form, plural. {count} is how many files, such as 3.

data.name: Connection_LegacyCredentialLeft_other
data.value: {count} anciens fichiers d'identifiants non chiffrés n'ont pas pu être déplacés vers le magasin d'identifiants de votre OS et se trouvent toujours sur le disque. Ouvrez les connexions concernées et enregistrez à nouveau leurs mots de passe pour les supprimer.
data.comment: Connection dialog: warning under the form, plural. {count} is how many files, such as 3.

data.name: Connection_CredentialStoreUnavailable
data.value: Le magasin d'identifiants de l'OS est indisponible.
data.comment: Connection dialog: the reason in an error line when the operating system's credential store cannot be used.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyTypeNotOffered
data.value: {server} n'a pas proposé de clé d'hôte du type sous lequel known_hosts le connaît ({types}). Cela arrive quand les clés du serveur ont été remplacées, et aussi quand quelqu'un intercepte la connexion entre vous et le serveur. pgNimbus ne s'est pas connecté. Si vous savez que les clés du serveur ont vraiment changé, supprimez ses lignes de known_hosts et reconnectez-vous ; il vous sera demandé de confirmer la nouvelle clé.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port, such as bastion.example.com:22. {types} lists key types, such as ssh-ed25519, ssh-rsa. known_hosts is a file name.

data.name: Connection_SshNoKeyFile
data.value: Aucun fichier de clé n'a été indiqué, et aucune des clés par défaut ({defaults}) ne se trouve dans {directory}.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {defaults} lists file names such as id_ed25519, id_rsa; {directory} is a folder path.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyFilePassphrase
data.value: Le fichier de clé {path} est protégé par une phrase secrète. Saisissez-la dans le champ de phrase secrète, ou choisissez « Agent SSH » si la clé y est déjà chargée (ssh-add).
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {path} is a file path. "SSH agent" is the Auth Method choice (translate as in the picker); ssh-add is a command.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyFileMissing
data.value: Le fichier de clé {path} n'existe pas.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {path} is a file path.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyFileUnreadable
data.value: Impossible de lire le fichier de clé {path} : {message}
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {path} is a file path; {message} is the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshKeyFileUnreadableWithPassphrase
data.value: Impossible de lire le fichier de clé {path} : {message} Si la clé a une phrase secrète, vérifiez qu'elle est correctement saisie.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line when a passphrase was typed. {path} is a file path; {message} is the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshNoAgentSocket
data.value: SSH_AUTH_SOCK n'est pas défini, il n'y a donc aucun agent SSH à interroger. Démarrez ssh-agent et ajoutez votre clé avec ssh-add, ou choisissez une autre méthode d'authentification.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. SSH_AUTH_SOCK, ssh-agent and ssh-add are names and stay.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentNoKeys
data.value: L'agent SSH à l'adresse {address} ne contient aucune clé. Ajoutez la vôtre avec ssh-add.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {address} is the agent's socket or pipe, such as /tmp/ssh-abc/agent.1.

data.name: Connection_SshLoginRefused
data.value: Le serveur SSH {server} a refusé la connexion de {user} : {message} {hint}
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port; {user} is the SSH user name; {message} is the server's reason; {hint} is one of the next three sentences.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthHintAgent
data.value: Aucune des clés de l'agent SSH n'est autorisée pour cet utilisateur sur le serveur.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error hint after a refused login using the agent.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthHintKey
data.value: Vérifiez que la moitié publique de cette clé figure dans ~/.ssh/authorized_keys de l'utilisateur sur le serveur.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error hint after a refused login using a key file.

data.name: Connection_SshAuthHintPassword
data.value: Vérifiez le mot de passe SSH.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error hint after a refused login using a password.

data.name: Connection_SshUnreachable
data.value: Impossible de joindre le serveur SSH {server} ({message}). Vérifiez l'adresse, et que le VPN ou le réseau derrière lequel il se trouve est actif.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port; {message} is the network's reason.

data.name: Connection_SshClosed
data.value: Le serveur SSH {server} a fermé la connexion : {message}
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port; {message} is the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshFailed
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port; {message} is the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshHostKeyRevoked
data.value: La clé {keyType} présentée par {server} ({fingerprint}) est marquée @revoked dans {file} (ligne {line}). pgNimbus ne s'est pas connecté.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {keyType} is such as ssh-ed25519; {server} is host:port; {fingerprint} is SHA256:…; {file} is a path to known_hosts; {line} is a line number. Keep @revoked.

data.name: Connection_SshHostKeyChanged
data.value: La clé d'hôte de {server} a changé. {file} (ligne {line}) connaît sa clé {keyType} sous la forme {known}, mais le serveur présente maintenant {fingerprint}. Cela arrive quand le serveur a été réinstallé ou ses clés régénérées, et aussi quand quelqu'un intercepte la connexion entre vous et le serveur. pgNimbus ne s'est pas connecté. Si vous savez que la clé a vraiment changé, supprimez cette ligne de {file} et reconnectez-vous ; il vous sera demandé de confirmer la nouvelle clé.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {server} is host:port; {file} is a path to known_hosts; {line} a line number; {keyType} such as ssh-ed25519; {known} and {fingerprint} are SHA256:… fingerprints.

data.name: Connection_SshHostKeyNotAccepted
data.value: La clé {keyType} de {server} ({fingerprint}) n'a pas été acceptée, pgNimbus ne s'est donc pas connecté.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line after the user refused an unknown host key. {keyType} is such as ssh-ed25519; {server} is host:port; {fingerprint} is SHA256:….

data.name: Connection_SshHostKeyNotConfirmed
data.value: La clé {keyType} de {server} ({fingerprint}) n'a pas pu être confirmée ({message}), pgNimbus ne s'est donc pas connecté.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line when the host key question failed. {keyType} such as ssh-ed25519; {server} host:port; {fingerprint} SHA256:…; {message} the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentRefusedList
data.value: L'agent SSH a refusé de lister ses clés.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentDeclinedSign
data.value: L'agent SSH a refusé de signer avec la clé (elle a pu être retirée, ou elle demande une confirmation qui a été refusée).
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentNoAnswer
data.value: Aucun agent SSH n'a répondu à l'adresse {address}. {hint}
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {address} is the agent's socket or pipe; {hint} is one of the next two sentences.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentStartHintWindows
data.value: Démarrez le service Windows « OpenSSH Authentication Agent » et ajoutez votre clé avec ssh-add.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error hint on Windows. "OpenSSH Authentication Agent" is the name of the Windows service as Windows shows it.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentStartHintOther
data.value: Vérifiez que SSH_AUTH_SOCK pointe vers un agent en cours d'exécution et ajoutez votre clé avec ssh-add.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentMalformed
data.value: L'agent SSH a envoyé une réponse malformée.
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentDropped
data.value: L'agent SSH à l'adresse {address} a interrompu la connexion : {message}
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {address} is the agent's socket or pipe; {message} is the reason.

data.name: Connection_SshAgentUnexpected
data.value: L'agent SSH a envoyé une réponse inattendue (type de message {messageType}).
data.comment: Connection dialog: SSH error line. {messageType} is a number.

data.value: Chaîne de connexion non reconnue. Formats pris en charge : URI postgres://, jdbc:postgresql://, Key=Value;..., libpq « host=... dbname=... », ou ligne de commande psql.
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line for a pasted string in no known format. Keep the format examples as they are.

data.name: Connection_ParseSegment

data.comment: Connection dialog: error line for a pasted Key=Value;… string.

data.name: Connection_ParseKeyword

data.comment: Connection dialog: error line for a pasted libpq keyword string.

data.name: Connection_ParseQuote

data.name: Connection_ParseOptionValue
data.comment: Connection dialog: error line for a pasted psql command line. {flag} is a command-line option, such as --host.

data.name: Connection_ParsePort

data.value: Mode SSL inconnu. Utilisez disable, allow, prefer, require, verify-ca ou verify-full.

data.name: Shell_AppMenuTip
data.comment: Main window, command bar at the top: tooltip of the three-line application-menu button.

data.name: Shell_MenuNewQueryTab
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that opens a new, empty query tab.

data.name: Shell_MenuOpen
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that opens a .sql file from disk. The ellipsis means a file picker follows.

data.name: Shell_MenuOpenRecent
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that opens a submenu of recently opened .sql files.

data.name: Shell_MenuNoRecentFiles
data.comment: Inside the Open Recent submenu: a disabled placeholder shown when no .sql file was opened yet.

data.name: Shell_MenuSaveAs
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item): save the current tab under a new name, as a file or as a saved query.

data.name: Shell_MenuSaveToSavedQueries
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item): save the current tab to the Saved Queries list in the sidebar. A name dialog follows.

data.name: Shell_MenuSaveToFile
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item): save the current tab to a .sql file on disk. A file picker may follow.

data.name: Shell_MenuCloseTab
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that closes the current query tab.

data.name: Shell_MenuReopenClosedTab
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that brings back the most recently closed query tab.

data.name: Shell_MenuSwitchConnection
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item): close this connection and pick another one in the connection dialog.

data.name: Shell_MenuNewConnectionWindow
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item): open the connection dialog to connect in an additional window, keeping this one.

data.name: Shell_MenuBackUpDatabase
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that opens the backup window (pg_dump).

data.name: Shell_MenuRestoreBackup
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (and macOS File menu item) that opens the restore window (pg_restore).

data.name: Shell_MenuSettings
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item that opens the Settings page.

data.name: Shell_MenuKeyboardShortcuts
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item (also macOS View menu item) that opens the keyboard shortcut sheet.

data.name: Shell_MenuAbout
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item that opens the About box. The product name stays.

data.name: Shell_MenuRateInStore
data.value: Noter pgNimbus dans le Microsoft Store
data.comment: Main window: the application menu opened by the three-line button at the top left (on macOS the same commands are in the menu bar). A menu item shown only in the Microsoft Store version: opens the store page to leave a rating.

data.name: Shell_ToggleSidebarTip

data.name: Shell_AllowWritesConfirm
data.value: Autoriser les écritures en production ({connection}) dans cette fenêtre ? Les instructions que vous exécutez, les modifications de la grille, les imports et les actions sur le schéma peuvent modifier des données jusqu'à ce que vous désactiviez les écritures ou fermiez la fenêtre. Les autres fenêtres gardent les écritures désactivées.

data.name: Shell_RenameDialogTitle

data.comment: Confirmation dialog of Switch Connection. {losses} is one or two sentences saying what closing the window would lose, such as "2 staged changes will be discarded."

data.name: Shell_SwitchConnectionButton

data.value: Les filtres s'appliquent en parcourant une table : double-cliquez sur l'une d'elles dans la barre latérale. Une requête que vous avez écrite n'est jamais réécrite ; ajoutez-y plutôt un WHERE.

data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses. Plural. {count} is how many changes staged in safe mode, such as 3.

data.name: Shell_LossStaged_other
data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses. Plural. {count} is how many changes staged in safe mode, such as 3.

data.name: Shell_LossRunning_one
data.value: la requête en cours sera annulée

data.name: Shell_LossRunning_other
data.comment: One item in the list of what closing a connection loses. Plural. {count} is how many queries are running, such as 2.
