data.value: Cliquez ensuite sur Rechercher à nouveau. pgNimbus les trouve tout seul dans le dossier libpq de Homebrew ; vous n'avez rien à ajouter à PATH.
data.comment: Install steps for macOS with Homebrew, last step. Look Again is the name of a button; PATH is the environment variable.

data.name: Backup_GuideMacApp
data.value: Téléchargez Postgres.app et déplacez-le dans Applications. Il inclut pg_dump et pg_restore ; vous n'avez pas à démarrer son serveur.
data.comment: Install steps for macOS, step 1. Postgres.app is a product name.

data.name: Backup_GuideMacAppLink
data.comment: Install steps for macOS, step 1: button that opens the Postgres.app website.

data.name: Backup_GuideMacOrBrew
data.comment: Install steps for macOS, step 2. A command to copy is shown under it.

data.name: Backup_GuideMacEither
data.value: Cliquez ensuite sur Rechercher à nouveau. pgNimbus les trouve tout seul dans l'un ou l'autre.
data.comment: Install steps for macOS, last step. Look Again is the name of a button.

data.name: Backup_GuideDebRepo
data.value: Ajoutez le dépôt de paquets propre à PostgreSQL. Les paquets de votre distribution sont souvent plus anciens que le serveur, et pg_dump ne peut pas être plus ancien :
data.comment: Install steps for Debian and Ubuntu, step 1. A command to copy is shown under it.

data.name: Backup_GuideLinkPostgresql
data.comment: Install steps for Linux: button that opens a page on postgresql.org.

data.name: Backup_GuideInstallClients
data.comment: Install steps for Linux, a step. A command to copy is shown under it.

data.name: Backup_GuideDebLookAgain
data.value: Cliquez ensuite sur Rechercher à nouveau. pgNimbus trouve /usr/lib/postgresql/{version}/bin tout seul.
data.comment: Install steps for Debian and Ubuntu, last step. Look Again is the name of a button; {version} is a PostgreSQL release, such as 18; the folder path is kept as it is.

data.name: Backup_GuideRhRepo
data.value: Ajoutez le dépôt de paquets propre à PostgreSQL pour votre distribution, comme le décrit postgresql.org.
data.comment: Install steps for Fedora and Red Hat, step 1.

data.name: Backup_GuideRhLookAgain
data.value: Cliquez ensuite sur Rechercher à nouveau. pgNimbus trouve /usr/pgsql-{version}/bin tout seul.
data.comment: Install steps for Fedora and Red Hat, last step. Look Again is the name of a button; {version} is a PostgreSQL release, such as 18; the folder path is kept as it is.

data.name: Backup_GuideLookAgain
data.value: Cliquez ensuite sur Rechercher à nouveau.
data.comment: Install steps for Linux, last step. Look Again is the name of a button.

data.name: Backup_GuideOtherLinux
data.value: Installez les programmes clients de PostgreSQL {version} (le paquet qui contient pg_dump et pg_restore) depuis votre distribution, ou depuis postgresql.org.
data.comment: Install steps for other Linux distributions, step 1. {version} is a PostgreSQL release, such as 18.

data.name: QueryLab_Title
data.comment: Window title of Query Lab, where saved query plans are compared. Query Lab is a feature name; pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: QueryLab_SavedPlans
data.comment: Query Lab: heading of the list of saved plans on the left.

data.name: QueryLab_ImportPlanButton
data.comment: Query Lab: button under the list that opens the paste-a-plan dialog.

data.name: QueryLab_ImportPlanTip
data.value: Collez un plan EXPLAIN venant d'un autre outil ou d'une autre machine et gardez-le ici ; aucune connexion nécessaire
data.comment: Query Lab: tooltip of the Import Plan button.

data.name: QueryLab_CompareAsBefore
data.comment: Query Lab, right-click menu of a saved plan: use it as the "before" side of the comparison.

data.name: QueryLab_CompareAsAfter
data.comment: Query Lab, right-click menu of a saved plan: use it as the "after" side of the comparison.

data.name: QueryLab_OpenInNewTab
data.comment: Query Lab, right-click menu of a saved plan: shows the plan in a new editor tab.

data.name: QueryLab_Rename
data.comment: Query Lab, right-click menu of a saved plan: asks for a new name.

data.name: QueryLab_Delete
data.comment: Query Lab, right-click menu of a saved plan: asks to delete it.

data.name: QueryLab_NoPlansHint
data.value: Les plans que vous enregistrez depuis le menu Comparer d'un onglet, ou importez ici, sont conservés sur cet ordinateur.
data.comment: Query Lab: shown in the list while no plan is saved. Compare is the name of a menu in the plan header.

data.name: QueryLab_Before
data.comment: Query Lab: label of the "before" side (a plan picker, a column of the figures).

data.name: QueryLab_After
data.comment: Query Lab: label of the "after" side (a plan picker, a column of the figures).

data.name: QueryLab_PickPlan
data.comment: Query Lab: placeholder of a plan picker with nothing chosen.

data.name: QueryLab_SwapTip
data.comment: Query Lab: tooltip of the button that exchanges the two sides.

data.name: QueryLab_TabSummary
data.comment: Query Lab: name of the tab with the summary figures.

data.name: QueryLab_TabPlanChanges
data.comment: Query Lab: name of the tab with the merged plan tree.

data.name: QueryLab_ChangeColumn
data.comment: Query Lab, summary table: caption of the column that shows how a figure changed.

data.name: QueryLab_SettingsDiffer
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: heading of the list of planner settings that differ between the two plans.

data.name: QueryLab_PlanWarnings
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: heading of the list of plan warnings that appeared or went away.

data.name: QueryLab_WhatChanged
data.comment: Query Lab, details of a plan node: small heading above the list of differences in what the node does.

data.name: QueryLab_SettingChange
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: one planner setting that differs. {name} is the setting, {before} and {after} its values or the word for default, such as enable_seqscan: default → off.

data.name: QueryLab_SettingDefault
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: stands for a planner setting's value when it was not changed from the server default.

data.name: QueryLab_SourceExplain
data.comment: Query Lab: tooltip line of a saved plan. It was made with the Explain command.

data.name: QueryLab_SourceRun
data.comment: Query Lab: tooltip line of a saved plan. It was made by running an EXPLAIN statement. EXPLAIN is SQL.

data.name: QueryLab_Imported
data.comment: Query Lab: a saved plan that was pasted in, not made here. Shown in the list line and the tooltip.

data.name: QueryLab_EstimatesOnly
data.comment: Query Lab: a plan that was not run (EXPLAIN without ANALYZE), so it holds the planner's estimates only. Shown in a list line beside the time.

data.name: QueryLab_ServerVersion
data.comment: Query Lab: the PostgreSQL server version a plan came from, in a list line. {version} is such as 17.11. PG is short for PostgreSQL.

data.name: QueryLab_UnsavedChoice
data.comment: Query Lab: the entry in a plan picker for the plan a tab shows that is not saved. {tab} is the tab's title.

data.name: QueryLab_EmptyNoPlans
data.value: Aucun plan enregistré pour l'instant. Affichez un plan dans un onglet avec Explain, Explain Analyze ou Importer un plan d'exécution, puis choisissez Enregistrer dans Query Lab dans son menu Comparer. Importer un plan ici en ajoute un sans connexion.
data.comment: Query Lab: what the right side says while no plan is saved. Explain, Explain Analyze, Import query plan, Save to Query Lab, Compare and Import Plan are names of commands and buttons.

data.name: QueryLab_EmptyPick
data.value: Choisissez un plan pour chaque côté afin de les comparer.
data.comment: Query Lab: what the right side says while one side has no plan chosen.

data.name: QueryLab_EmptySame
data.comment: Query Lab: what the right side says when both sides are the same plan.

data.name: QueryLab_Comparing
data.comment: Query Lab: shown while a comparison is being computed.

data.name: QueryLab_SavedStatus
data.comment: Query Lab, status line: a plan was saved. {name} is the plan's name.

data.name: QueryLab_DeletedStatus
data.comment: Query Lab, status line: a saved plan was deleted. {name} is the plan's name.

data.name: QueryLab_SaveImportedHeading
data.comment: Heading of the naming dialog that opens after a plan was pasted into Query Lab.

data.name: QueryLab_RenameHeading
data.comment: Heading of the naming dialog that renames a saved plan.

data.name: QueryLab_ImportedName
data.comment: Query Lab: the name suggested for a plan that was pasted in. A number is added if the name is taken.

data.name: QueryLab_PlanMissing
data.value: Le plan enregistré sous « {name} » est absent du dossier de Query Lab.
data.comment: Query Lab, status line: the file of a saved plan could not be found. {name} is the plan's name.

data.name: QueryLab_ConfirmDelete
data.value: Supprimer le plan enregistré « {name} » de Query Lab ? Un onglet qui l'affiche le garde jusqu'à sa fermeture.
data.comment: Confirmation dialog of deleting a saved plan. {name} is the plan's name.

data.name: QueryLab_SameNodes
data.value: Même plan : tous les nœuds correspondent
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: line above the tree when the two plans have no difference.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesChanged_one
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: part of the line above the tree, the number of plan nodes that changed. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesChanged_other
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: part of the line above the tree, the number of plan nodes that changed. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesAdded_one
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that are new. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesAdded_other
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that are new. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesRemoved_one
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that are gone. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesRemoved_other
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that are gone. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesMoved_one
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that moved to another place in the tree. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_NodesMoved_other
data.comment: Query Lab, plan changes tab: the number of plan nodes that moved to another place in the tree. Plural. {number} is such as 2.

data.name: QueryLab_WarningNew
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: marks a plan warning that appears only in the after plan.

data.name: QueryLab_WarningGone
data.comment: Query Lab, summary: marks a plan warning that appears only in the before plan.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeChanged
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that exists in both plans but differs.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeAdded
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that exists only in the after plan.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeRemoved
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that exists only in the before plan.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeMoved
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that is the same but sits somewhere else in the tree.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeSame
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that did not change.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeChangedMoved
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that differs and also moved.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeAddedMoved
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that is new and sits in a different place than its twin would.

data.name: QueryLab_NodeRemovedMoved
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: word beside a node that is gone and sat in a different place.

data.name: QueryLab_WasHeader
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: after a node's name, says what the node was in the before plan. {header} is such as Seq Scan on orders o.

data.name: QueryLab_LineRows
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line of a node. {value} is the actual row count on both sides, such as 40 → 40.

data.name: QueryLab_LineEstRows
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line of a node in a plan that was not run. est. is short for estimated. {value} is the planner's row estimate on both sides.

data.name: QueryLab_LineSelf
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. The time the node spent itself, without its children. {value} is such as 12 ms → 0.4 ms, with a leading ~ when approximate.

data.name: QueryLab_LineHit
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. Shared buffer blocks found in cache. {value} is a count on both sides.

data.name: QueryLab_LineRead
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. Shared buffer blocks read from disk. {value} is a count on both sides.

data.name: QueryLab_LineDisk
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. What went to disk on each side, such as Sort 4 MB, or the word for none.

data.name: QueryLab_None
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: nothing went to disk on that side.

data.name: QueryLab_NeverExecuted
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. The node never ran in either plan.

data.name: QueryLab_NeverExecutedBefore
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. The node never ran in the before plan.

data.name: QueryLab_NeverExecutedAfter
data.comment: Query Lab, plan tree: figure line. The node never ran in the after plan.

data.name: QueryLab_FigEstRows
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, the planner's row estimate for one loop of the node.

data.name: QueryLab_FigActRows
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, the rows the node returned in one loop.

data.name: QueryLab_FigLoops
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, how many times the node ran.

data.name: QueryLab_FigInclusiveTime
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, the node's time including the nodes below it.

data.name: QueryLab_FigSelfTime
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, the node's time without the nodes below it.

data.name: QueryLab_FigCost
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, the planner's cost estimate in its own units, not a time.

data.name: QueryLab_FigBuffersHit
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, blocks found in PostgreSQL's shared buffer cache.

data.name: QueryLab_FigBuffersRead
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, blocks read from outside the shared buffers.

data.name: QueryLab_FigTempWritten
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, blocks written to temporary files.

data.name: QueryLab_FigDisk
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: name of a figure, whether the node spilled to disk.

data.name: QueryLab_No
data.comment: Query Lab, node details: the answer "no" to Went to disk.

data.name: Plan_MoreTitle_one
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a line that sums up the warnings of one kind not listed above it. Plural. {number} is a count such as 1,200; {kind} is a warning heading, such as 'Sort spilled to disk' or 'Row estimates off'.

data.name: Plan_MoreTitle_other
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a line that sums up the warnings of one kind not listed above it. Plural. {number} is a count such as 1,200; {kind} is a warning heading, such as 'Sort spilled to disk' or 'Row estimates off'.

data.name: Plan_MoreDetail_one
data.value: Idem pour {number} autre nœud de ce plan. La vue texte les liste tous.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under the 'N more' heading. Plural. {number} is a count such as 1,200. The text view is the plan shown as EXPLAIN text.

data.name: Plan_MoreDetail_other
data.value: Idem pour {number} autres nœuds de ce plan. La vue texte les liste tous.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under the 'N more' heading. Plural. {number} is a count such as 1,200. The text view is the plan shown as EXPLAIN text.

data.name: Plan_RowEstimateTitle
data.value: Estimation de lignes erronée d'un facteur {factor}×
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a warning that the planner's row estimate was wrong. {factor} is how many times off, such as 120.

data.name: Plan_RowEstimateKind
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): the name of the 'row estimate off' warnings as a group, shown in the 'N more: …' line.

data.name: Plan_RowEstimateOverDetail
data.value: Le planificateur a surestimé {node} : {estimated} lignes estimées, {actual} réelles. Des statistiques périmées ou des colonnes corrélées peuvent l'induire en erreur — essayez ANALYZE ou les statistiques étendues.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): the planner expected more rows than the node returned. {node} is the plan node as EXPLAIN writes it, such as 'Seq Scan on orders o'; {estimated} and {actual} are row counts such as 5000 and 12. ANALYZE is a PostgreSQL command; keep it.

data.name: Plan_RowEstimateUnderDetail
data.value: Le planificateur a sous-estimé {node} : {estimated} lignes estimées, {actual} réelles. Des statistiques périmées ou des colonnes corrélées peuvent l'induire en erreur — essayez ANALYZE ou les statistiques étendues.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): the planner expected fewer rows than the node returned. {node} is the plan node as EXPLAIN writes it, such as 'Seq Scan on orders o'; {estimated} and {actual} are row counts such as 12 and 5000. ANALYZE is a PostgreSQL command; keep it.

data.name: Plan_SortSpillTitle
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a warning that a sort did not fit in memory.

data.name: Plan_SortSpillDetail
data.value: Ce tri a utilisé une méthode sur disque ({method}). Augmenter work_mem peut le garder en mémoire.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Sort spilled to disk'. {method} is PostgreSQL's name of the sort method, such as 'external merge'. work_mem is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: Plan_SortSpillDetailSize
data.value: Ce tri a utilisé une méthode sur disque ({method}) ({size} kB). Augmenter work_mem peut le garder en mémoire.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Sort spilled to disk', when the plan says how much it wrote. {method} is PostgreSQL's name of the sort method, such as 'external merge'; {size} is a number of kilobytes such as 2400. work_mem is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: Plan_HashSpillTitle
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a warning that a hash table did not fit in memory.

data.name: Plan_HashSpillDetail
data.value: Le hash a utilisé {batches} lots (>1 signifie qu'il ne tenait pas en mémoire). Augmenter work_mem peut réduire le découpage en lots.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Hash spilled to disk'. {batches} is a number greater than 1, such as 4. work_mem is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: Plan_SeqScanTitle
data.value: Un scan séquentiel écarte la plupart des lignes
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a warning that a full table scan threw away most of what it read.

data.name: Plan_SeqScanDetail
data.value: Le scan a lu {scanned} lignes et en a filtré {removed}. Un index sur la ou les colonnes filtrées permettrait au planificateur d'ignorer les lignes écartées.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Sequential scan discards most rows', when the plan names no table. {scanned} and {removed} are row counts such as 100000 and 99950.

data.name: Plan_SeqScanDetailOn
data.value: Le scan sur {relation} a lu {scanned} lignes et en a filtré {removed}. Un index sur la ou les colonnes filtrées permettrait au planificateur d'ignorer les lignes écartées.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Sequential scan discards most rows'. {relation} is a table name, such as orders; {scanned} and {removed} are row counts such as 100000 and 99950.

data.name: Plan_LossyTitle
data.value: Le scan bitmap est devenu lossy
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): heading of a warning that a bitmap scan's bitmap did not fit in memory, so it kept whole pages instead of rows.

data.name: Plan_LossyDetail
data.value: {blocks} blocs de heap ont été revérifiés en mode lossy parce que le bitmap a dépassé work_mem. Augmenter work_mem permet de garder plus du bitmap exact.
data.comment: Plan warnings strip (above a query plan, and in Query Lab's warning lists): text under 'Bitmap scan went lossy'. {blocks} is a number of table pages, such as 120. work_mem is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: Plan_NothingToExplain
data.value: Rien à expliquer : sélectionnez ou écrivez d'abord une instruction.
data.comment: Status line after Explain or Explain Analyze with an empty editor or selection.

data.name: Plan_OneStatementOnly_one
data.value: EXPLAIN accepte une seule instruction, et {count} ont été fournies. Sélectionnez une seule instruction.
data.comment: Status line after Explain with a selection of several SQL statements. Plural. {count} is how many statements, such as 2. EXPLAIN is a PostgreSQL command; keep it.

data.name: Plan_OneStatementOnly_other
data.value: EXPLAIN accepte une seule instruction, et {count} ont été fournies. Sélectionnez une seule instruction.
data.comment: Status line after Explain with a selection of several SQL statements. Plural. {count} is how many statements, such as 2. EXPLAIN is a PostgreSQL command; keep it.

data.name: Plan_InvalidJson
data.value: Cela ne ressemble pas à un JSON EXPLAIN valide : {reason}
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: the pasted or returned plan is not readable JSON. {reason} is the JSON reader's own message, in English.

data.name: Plan_JsonArrayEmpty
data.value: Le tableau JSON EXPLAIN est vide.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: the pasted JSON plan is an empty array, [].

data.name: Plan_JsonNoPlan
data.value: JSON EXPLAIN non reconnu : aucun élément "Plan" ou "Node Type" trouvé.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. "Plan" and "Node Type" are the names of JSON properties in PostgreSQL's EXPLAIN output; keep them as they are.

data.name: Plan_JsonPlanNotObject
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. "Plan" is the name of a JSON property; keep it. An object is a JSON object, {…}.

data.name: Plan_JsonPlansNotArray
data.value: Le "Plans" d'un nœud n'est pas un tableau.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. "Plans" is the name of a JSON property; keep it. An array is a JSON array, […].

data.name: Plan_JsonChildNotObject
data.value: Un plan enfant n'est pas un objet.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. An object is a JSON object, {…}.

data.name: Plan_JsonNoNodeType
data.value: Un nœud du plan n'a pas de "Node Type".
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. "Node Type" is the name of a JSON property; keep it.

data.name: Plan_NothingToImport
data.value: Rien à importer — collez d'abord un plan EXPLAIN.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: the box was empty.

data.name: Plan_TextTooLarge
data.value: Le plan est trop volumineux pour être importé (plus de {size} Mo de texte).
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. {size} is a number of megabytes, such as 4.

data.name: Plan_TextLineTimeout
data.value: La lecture d'une ligne du plan a pris trop de temps.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: reading one line of a pasted text plan was stopped after a time limit.

data.name: Plan_TextNoNode
data.value: Cela ne ressemble pas à un plan EXPLAIN en texte — la première ligne ne contient aucun nœud de plan.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: the pasted text does not start with a plan node such as 'Seq Scan on orders'.

data.name: Plan_TextBadNode
data.value: Impossible d'analyser un nœud du plan à partir de : {line}
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. {line} is the line of the pasted plan that could not be read, as it was pasted.

data.name: Plan_TextBadIndent
data.value: L'indentation du plan est incohérente — impossible de placer un nœud enfant.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog: the pasted text plan's indentation does not show which node a line belongs under.

data.name: Plan_TextTooDeep
data.value: Le plan s'imbrique sur plus de {depth} niveaux, plus que pgNimbus n'en lit.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog. {depth} is a number such as 128.

data.name: Plan_TextNoPlan
data.value: Aucun nœud de plan trouvé dans le texte collé.
data.comment: Error shown on the status line or in the Import Query Plan dialog.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ExecutionTime
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the time the query took to run.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PlanningTime
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the time the planner took.

data.name: QueryLabCore_JitTime
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the time spent on JIT compilation. JIT is a PostgreSQL term; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TriggerTime
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the time spent in triggers.

data.name: QueryLabCore_RowsReturned
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, how many rows the query returned.

data.name: QueryLabCore_RowsEstimated
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, how many rows the planner expected.

data.name: QueryLabCore_EstimatedCost
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the planner's cost estimate. Planner units are PostgreSQL's arbitrary cost units, not time.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SharedHit
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, pages found in PostgreSQL's shared buffers (its cache). Shared buffers is a PostgreSQL term.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SharedRead
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, pages read into PostgreSQL's shared buffers from outside them.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TempRead
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, temporary-file blocks read.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TempWritten
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, temporary-file blocks written.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PlanningBuffers
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, the pages the planner touched.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NodesToDisk
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: name of a row, how many plan nodes ran out of memory and used disk.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NotAnalyzed
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: why a side has no figure (tooltip of its dash): the plan came from EXPLAIN without ANALYZE.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NotReported
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: why a side has no planning time (tooltip of its dash): the plan does not say.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NotMeasured
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: why a side has no row count (tooltip of its dash).

data.name: QueryLabCore_NoBuffers
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: why a side has no buffer counts (tooltip of its dash): the plan was made without the BUFFERS option. BUFFERS is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_BuffersUnknown
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: why a side has no buffer counts (tooltip of its dash): the plan does not say whether the BUFFERS option was on. BUFFERS is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_OneRunEach
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: a short caveat beside Execution time: each side was measured once.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NoChange
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, the table of figures: the Change column when a figure is the same on both sides.

data.name: QueryLabCore_EstimatesOnlyTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. Neither or one plan was run with ANALYZE.

data.name: QueryLabCore_EstimatesOnlyNeither
data.value: Aucun des deux plans n'a été analysé : il n'y a donc ni durée, ni nombre réel de lignes, ni utilisation des buffers à comparer, seulement les estimations du planificateur. Le coût estimé est en unités du planificateur, pas en temps.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Estimates only', when neither plan was run with ANALYZE.

data.name: QueryLabCore_EstimatesOnlyBefore
data.value: Le plan avant n'a pas été analysé : il n'y a donc ni durée, ni nombre réel de lignes, ni utilisation des buffers à comparer de ce côté, seulement les estimations du planificateur. Le coût estimé est en unités du planificateur, pas en temps.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Estimates only', when the before plan was not run with ANALYZE. 'Before' is the left side of the comparison.

data.name: QueryLabCore_EstimatesOnlyAfter
data.value: Le plan après n'a pas été analysé : il n'y a donc ni durée, ni nombre réel de lignes, ni utilisation des buffers à comparer de ce côté, seulement les estimations du planificateur. Le coût estimé est en unités du planificateur, pas en temps.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Estimates only', when the after plan was not run with ANALYZE. 'After' is the right side of the comparison.

data.name: QueryLabCore_OneRunTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. Each side was measured once.

data.name: QueryLabCore_OneRunDetail
data.value: Chaque côté est une exécution unique. Les durées varient d'une exécution à l'autre, selon la charge du serveur et ce qui est déjà en mémoire : exécutez chacun plusieurs fois avant de tirer des conclusions de l'écart.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'One run each'. Must not say which side is faster or better.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TimingOffTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. A plan was run with EXPLAIN's TIMING OFF option.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TimingOffBoth
data.value: Les deux plans ont été exécutés avec TIMING OFF : seule la durée totale d'exécution est comparable, pas celle de chaque nœud.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Timing was off'. TIMING OFF is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TimingOffBefore
data.value: Le plan avant a été exécuté avec TIMING OFF : seule la durée totale d'exécution est comparable, pas celle de chaque nœud.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Timing was off'. TIMING OFF is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TimingOffAfter
data.value: Le plan après a été exécuté avec TIMING OFF : seule la durée totale d'exécution est comparable, pas celle de chaque nœud.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Timing was off'. TIMING OFF is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheTitle
data.value: Le cache peut expliquer une partie de l'écart
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. One side read much more from disk than the other.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheBeforeMore
data.value: L'exécution avant a lu {more} blocs hors des shared buffers (le disque ou le cache du système) et l'exécution après {less}. Une exécution dont les données sont déjà en mémoire lit moins sur disque, quel que soit son plan. Relancez les deux à tour de rôle, ou comparez les buffers touchés par chaque nœud.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under the cache heading, when the before side read more. {more} and {less} are block counts such as 12,400 and 80. Shared buffers is PostgreSQL's cache.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheAfterMore
data.value: L'exécution après a lu {more} blocs hors des shared buffers (le disque ou le cache du système) et l'exécution avant {less}. Une exécution dont les données sont déjà en mémoire lit moins sur disque, quel que soit son plan. Relancez les deux à tour de rôle, ou comparez les buffers touchés par chaque nœud.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under the cache heading, when the after side read more. {more} and {less} are block counts such as 12,400 and 80. Shared buffers is PostgreSQL's cache.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheUnknownTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. A plan has no buffer counts.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheUnknownNeither
data.value: Aucun des deux plans n'a de compteurs de buffers : un cache chaud ne peut donc pas se distinguer d'un changement de plan. L'Explain Analyze de pgNimbus demande toujours BUFFERS.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Cache use unknown'. Explain Analyze is the name of a pgNimbus command; BUFFERS is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheUnknownBefore
data.value: Le plan avant n'a pas de compteurs de buffers : un cache chaud ne peut donc pas se distinguer d'un changement de plan. L'Explain Analyze de pgNimbus demande toujours BUFFERS.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Cache use unknown'. Explain Analyze is the name of a pgNimbus command; BUFFERS is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CacheUnknownAfter
data.value: Le plan après n'a pas de compteurs de buffers : un cache chaud ne peut donc pas se distinguer d'un changement de plan. L'Explain Analyze de pgNimbus demande toujours BUFFERS.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Cache use unknown'. Explain Analyze is the name of a pgNimbus command; BUFFERS is an EXPLAIN option; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_VersionsTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading.

data.name: QueryLabCore_VersionsDetail
data.value: Le plan avant vient de PostgreSQL {before} et le plan après de {after}. Le planificateur, son modèle de coût et l'exécuteur diffèrent d'une version à l'autre.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Different PostgreSQL versions'. {before} and {after} are server versions, such as 16.4 and 17.2.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CostScalesTitle
data.value: Les coûts sont à des échelles différentes
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. Settings that scale the planner's costs differ.

data.name: QueryLabCore_CostScalesDetail
data.value: Les paramètres qui mettent à l'échelle les coûts du planificateur diffèrent ({settings}) : ses coûts estimés sont donc dans des unités différentes de chaque côté.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Costs are on different scales'. {settings} is a list of PostgreSQL setting names, such as 'random_page_cost, seq_page_cost'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SettingsUnknownTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. One plan does not list its planner settings.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SettingsUnknownBefore
data.value: Le plan avant n'indique pas quels paramètres du planificateur ont été modifiés par rapport aux valeurs par défaut : les paramètres ne peuvent donc pas être comparés.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Settings unknown on one side'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SettingsUnknownAfter
data.value: Le plan après n'indique pas quels paramètres du planificateur ont été modifiés par rapport aux valeurs par défaut : les paramètres ne peuvent donc pas être comparés.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Settings unknown on one side'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_JitTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. JIT is a PostgreSQL term; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_JitBefore
data.value: Le JIT a pris {time} de l'exécution avant, et fait partie de sa durée d'exécution. Il démarre au-dessus de jit_above_cost : un changement d'estimations peut donc l'activer ou le désactiver.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under the JIT heading. {time} is a duration such as '12.5 ms'. jit_above_cost is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_JitAfter
data.value: Le JIT a pris {time} de l'exécution après, et fait partie de sa durée d'exécution. Il démarre au-dessus de jit_above_cost : un changement d'estimations peut donc l'activer ou le désactiver.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under the JIT heading. {time} is a duration such as '12.5 ms'. jit_above_cost is a PostgreSQL setting; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ConnectionsTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ConnectionsDetail
data.value: Le plan avant a été exécuté sur {before} et le plan après sur {after} : les données, les statistiques et le serveur peuvent différer.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Different connections'. {before} and {after} are connection names such as 'db.example.com/shop'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_StatementsTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. The two plans are for different SQL text.

data.name: QueryLabCore_StatementsDetail
data.value: Les deux plans concernent des textes d'instruction différents : un écart peut donc venir de la réécriture autant que des données, des statistiques ou des index.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Different statements'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_RowsTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. The two runs returned different numbers of rows.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeTitle
data.value: La forme du plan a changé
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. Plan nodes were added, removed or moved.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeDetail
data.value: {changes}. L'onglet Changements du plan montre où.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'The plan's shape changed'. {changes} is a list such as '2 nodes added and 1 node removed'; its first letter is made upper case. Plan changes is the name of a tab.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeAdded_one
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeAdded_other
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeRemoved_one
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeRemoved_other
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeMoved_one
data.value: {number} nœud déplacé vers un autre parent
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3. A parent is the plan node above it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ShapeMoved_other
data.value: {number} nœuds déplacés vers un autre parent
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: part of the list in the 'shape changed' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 3. A parent is the plan node above it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ListTwo
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: joins two parts of a list, such as '2 nodes added and 1 node removed'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_ListThree
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: joins three parts of a list, such as '2 nodes added, 1 node removed and 1 node moved to another parent'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersShortTitle
data.value: Moins de workers parallèles que prévu
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading. A Gather node started fewer parallel workers than it planned.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersShortBefore
data.value: Un Gather a lancé moins de workers que prévu dans l'exécution avant : le serveur n'en avait plus de disponibles (max_parallel_workers), ce qui change la durée sans changer le plan.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Fewer parallel workers than planned'. Gather is a plan node name and max_parallel_workers a PostgreSQL setting; keep them.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersShortAfter
data.value: Un Gather a lancé moins de workers que prévu dans l'exécution après : le serveur n'en avait plus de disponibles (max_parallel_workers), ce qui change la durée sans changer le plan.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Fewer parallel workers than planned'. Gather is a plan node name and max_parallel_workers a PostgreSQL setting; keep them.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersShortBoth
data.value: Un Gather a lancé moins de workers que prévu dans les exécutions avant et après : le serveur n'en avait plus de disponibles (max_parallel_workers), ce qui change la durée sans changer le plan.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Fewer parallel workers than planned', when both runs were short. Gather is a plan node name and max_parallel_workers a PostgreSQL setting; keep them.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersDiffTitle
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: heading.

data.name: QueryLabCore_WorkersDiffDetail
data.value: Un Gather s'est exécuté avec {before} avant et {after} après, ce qui change sa durée sans que le plan change.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Different numbers of parallel workers'. {before} and {after} are counts of workers, such as '2 workers' and '1 worker'. Gather is a plan node name; keep it.

data.name: QueryLabCore_Workers_one
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: a count of parallel workers, used in the 'different numbers of parallel workers' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 2.

data.name: QueryLabCore_Workers_other
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: a count of parallel workers, used in the 'different numbers of parallel workers' note. Plural. {number} is a count such as 2.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillSort
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk, shown beside 'Went to disk' and on the node's line.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillSortSize
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk. {size} is a number of kilobytes such as 2400.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillHash
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk: its hash table was split. {batches} is a number greater than 1, such as 4.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillHashAggregate
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk: its hash aggregate was split. {batches} is a number greater than 1, such as 5.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillDisk
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk. {size} is a number of kilobytes such as 2400.

data.name: QueryLabCore_SpillTemp
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: why a plan node went to disk: it wrote temporary-file blocks. {blocks} is a count such as 120.

data.name: QueryLabCore_FoldedAdded_one
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: a row of the tree that stands for many scans added at once (a partition list changed). Plural. {number} is a count such as 312.

data.name: QueryLabCore_FoldedAdded_other
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: a row of the tree that stands for many scans added at once (a partition list changed). Plural. {number} is a count such as 312.

data.name: QueryLabCore_FoldedRemoved_one
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: a row of the tree that stands for many scans removed at once (a partition list changed). Plural. {number} is a count such as 312.

data.name: QueryLabCore_FoldedRemoved_other
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab: a row of the tree that stands for many scans removed at once (a partition list changed). Plural. {number} is a count such as 312.

data.name: QueryLabCore_InputsSwapped
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: a join's two inputs changed sides.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NowParallel
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: the node runs in parallel in the after plan and did not before.

data.name: QueryLabCore_NoLongerParallel
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: the node ran in parallel in the before plan and does not now.

data.name: QueryLabCore_DetailRemoved
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: a condition only the before plan had. {key} is PostgreSQL's name of it, such as 'Filter' or 'Index Cond'; {value} is the condition, such as '(customer_id = 42)'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_DetailAdded
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: a condition only the after plan has. {key} is PostgreSQL's name of it, such as 'Recheck Cond'; {value} is the condition, such as '(customer_id = 42)'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropertyChange
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: a property that differs. {property} is one of the property names below, such as 'join type'; {before} and {after} are PostgreSQL's values, such as Inner and Left, or 'none'.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropJoinType
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of a join node (Inner, Left, …).

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropStrategy
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of an aggregate or set operation node (Plain, Sorted, Hashed).

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropMode
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of an aggregate node (Simple, Partial, Finalize).

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropOperation
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of a ModifyTable node (Insert, Update, Delete).

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropIndex
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of an index scan, the index it uses.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PropDirection
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: name of a property of an index scan (Forward, Backward).

data.name: QueryLabCore_NoValue
data.comment: Query Lab, Plan changes tab, 'What changed' list of a changed node: the value of a property one side does not have, such as no index.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PlanTooLarge
data.value: Ce plan dépasse {size} Mo de texte, plus que Query Lab n'en conserve.
data.comment: Query Lab, status line after saving or changing a saved plan failed. {size} is a number of megabytes, such as 4. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: QueryLabCore_TooManyPlans
data.value: Query Lab conserve déjà {count} plans, le maximum. Supprimez-en pour en enregistrer un autre.
data.comment: Query Lab, status line after saving or changing a saved plan failed. {count} is the limit, such as 200. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: QueryLabCore_IndexUnreadable
data.value: La liste des plans enregistrés de Query Lab ({path}) est illisible : rien n'a été modifié.
data.comment: Query Lab, status line after saving or changing a saved plan failed. {path} is the path of a file. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: QueryLabCore_IndexWriteFailed
data.value: Query Lab n'a pas pu écrire sa liste de plans enregistrés : {reason}
data.comment: Query Lab, status line after saving or changing a saved plan failed. {reason} is the operating system's message, such as 'Access denied'. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: QueryLabCore_PlanWriteFailed
data.value: Query Lab n'a pas pu enregistrer le plan : {reason}
data.comment: Query Lab, status line after saving or changing a saved plan failed. {reason} is the operating system's message, such as 'Access denied'. Query Lab is a feature name.

data.name: QueryLabCore_RowCountsDetail
data.value: Les deux exécutions ont renvoyé des nombres de lignes différents (avant : {before}, après : {after}) : les données ou l'instruction ont changé entre-temps, elles n'ont donc pas fait le même travail.
data.comment: Query Lab, Summary tab, a note about what the comparison can and cannot show: text under 'Different rows returned'. {before} and {after} are the row counts of the two runs, such as 1,200 and 1,180.

data.name: Crash_Title
data.comment: Window title of the crash window shown after an unexpected failure. pgNimbus is the product name.

data.name: Crash_Heading
data.value: pgNimbus a rencontré une erreur inattendue
data.comment: Crash window: heading.

data.name: Crash_Body
data.value: L'application a rencontré une erreur critique et doit se fermer. Ce que vous faisiez n'est pas forcément perdu — rouvrez pgNimbus pour continuer.
data.comment: Crash window: what happened and what to do next.

data.name: Crash_LogLabel
data.value: Un journal détaillé a été enregistré dans :
data.comment: Crash window: label above the path of the log file.

data.name: Crash_ReportHint
data.value: Merci de le signaler pour qu'il soit corrigé — le bouton ci-dessous ouvre un ticket GitHub prérempli. Joindre le fichier journal ci-dessus aide beaucoup.
data.comment: Crash window: asks the user to report the crash. The GitHub issue it opens is in English on purpose.

data.name: Crash_OpenLog
data.comment: Crash window: button that opens the folder holding the log file.

data.name: Crash_Report
data.comment: Crash window: button that opens a pre-filled GitHub issue in the browser.

data.name: Crash_NoLog
data.value: Aucun journal n'a été écrit : pgNimbus n'a trouvé aucun dossier de données d'application.
data.comment: Crash window: shown in place of the log path when no log could be written.

data.name: Crash_UnknownError
data.comment: Crash window: shown in the error box when there is no error message to show.

data.name: Core_QueryTransactionLost
data.value: La connexion au serveur a été perdue. La transaction ouverte a disparu et rien n'y a été validé. L'instruction suivante se reconnectera automatiquement.
data.comment: Error shown in the results pane (and the status line) when the connection dropped inside an explicit transaction (BEGIN … COMMIT). Everything in the transaction was rolled back by the server.

data.name: Core_QueryLostAfterSend
data.value: La connexion au serveur a été perdue pendant l'exécution de l'instruction : {detail}. Elle n'a pas été réexécutée : elle a pu avoir un effet ou non ; vérifiez avant de la relancer. L'instruction suivante se reconnectera automatiquement.
data.comment: Error shown in the results pane, the status line or the Add row dialog when the connection dropped after a statement was sent, so nobody knows whether the server applied it. {detail} is the driver's or server's own message, in English, such as "Exception while reading from stream" or "terminating connection due to administrator command".

data.name: Core_QueryLostNotReconnected
data.value: La connexion au serveur a été perdue et n'a pas pu être rétablie : {detail}
data.comment: Error shown in the results pane and the status line when the connection dropped before a statement was sent and the one automatic reconnect failed too. Nothing ran. {detail} is the driver's or server's own message, in English, such as "Failed to connect to 127.0.0.1:5432".

data.name: Core_StagedRowIsDeleted
data.value: Cette ligne est en attente de suppression — appuyez de nouveau sur Suppr sur elle pour retirer d'abord la suppression de l'attente.
data.comment: Status line in safe mode: the user tried to edit a cell of a row already staged for deletion. "Delete" is the Delete key.

data.name: Core_ImportFileTooLarge
data.value: Le fichier dépasse {megabytes} Mo, le maximum que pgNimbus importe en une fois. Découpez-le en fichiers plus petits, ou chargez-le avec \copy de psql.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: the chosen CSV or JSON file is too big. {megabytes} is the limit in mebibytes, formatted, such as "512". "\copy" is a psql command, keep it as is.

data.name: Core_ImportTooManyRows
data.value: Le fichier contient plus de {rows} lignes, le maximum que pgNimbus importe en une fois. Découpez-le en fichiers plus petits.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: the CSV or JSON file has too many rows. {rows} is the limit, formatted, such as "1,000,000".

data.name: Core_ImportTooManyColumns
data.value: Le fichier contient plus de {columns} colonnes, le maximum que pgNimbus importe dans une table.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: the CSV or JSON file has too many columns. {columns} is the limit, formatted, such as "1,000".

data.name: Core_ImportTooManyCells
data.value: Le fichier produirait {cells} cellules (lignes × colonnes), plus que les {max} que pgNimbus importe en une fois. Importez moins de lignes ou de colonnes à la fois.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: rows times columns of the file is too many. {cells} is that product, formatted, such as "62,000,000"; {max} is the limit, formatted, such as "50,000,000".

data.name: Core_ImportJsonNotArray
data.value: Un tableau JSON d'objets était attendu.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: a JSON file to import is not an array at its top level.

data.name: Core_ImportJsonNotObject
data.value: Chaque élément du tableau devait être un objet JSON.
data.comment: Shown after "Import failed:" on the status line: an element of the JSON array to import is not an object (it is a number, a string, an array …).

data.name: Core_RelationNounTable
data.comment: The word for a table, lower case, put into sentences such as "Rename {noun} "public.orders"" and "Drop {noun} …?" in a table's Maintenance menu.

data.name: Core_RelationNounView
data.comment: The word for a view (a stored query), lower case, put into sentences such as "Rename {noun} "public.orders"" in a table's Maintenance menu.

data.name: Core_RelationNounMaterializedView
data.comment: The word for a materialized view (a stored query whose rows are kept), lower case, put into sentences such as "Rename {noun} "public.orders"" in a table's Maintenance menu.

data.name: Core_RenameEmpty
data.comment: Status line: the name typed in the Rename dialog of a table's Maintenance menu is empty.

data.name: Core_RenameNul
data.value: Un nom ne peut pas contenir de caractère NUL.
data.comment: Status line: the name typed in the Rename dialog of a table's Maintenance menu contains a NUL (zero) character.

data.name: Core_RenameTooLong
data.value: Le nouveau nom dépasse {bytes} octets, et PostgreSQL le tronquerait.
data.comment: Status line: the name typed in the Rename dialog of a table's Maintenance menu is too long. {bytes} is the limit, such as 63.

data.name: Core_UnitMilliseconds
data.comment: A duration in milliseconds, in Query Lab, Slow Queries and the plan views. {value} is a number written with a dot, such as 0.25 or 1,025.5. Write the unit as your language abbreviates it.

data.name: Core_UnitSeconds
data.comment: A duration in seconds, in Query Lab and Slow Queries. {value} is a number such as 3.3. Write the unit as your language abbreviates it.

data.name: Core_UnitMinutes
data.comment: A duration in minutes, in Slow Queries. {value} is a number such as 1.5. Write the unit as your language abbreviates it.

data.name: Core_UnitHours
data.comment: A duration in hours, in Slow Queries. {value} is a number such as 2.0. Write the unit as your language abbreviates it.

data.name: Core_UnitBytes_one
data.comment: A size under one kilobyte, in Database Overview, the schema tree and the Backup window. {count} is a whole number such as 512.

data.name: Core_UnitBytes_other
data.comment: A size under one kilobyte, in Database Overview, the schema tree and the Backup window. {count} is a whole number such as 512.

data.name: Core_UnitKilobytes
data.comment: A size in kilobytes (1024 bytes), in Database Overview, the schema tree and the Backup window. {value} is a number with one decimal, such as 208.0. Write the unit as your language abbreviates it.

data.name: Core_UnitMegabytes
data.comment: A size in megabytes, as Core_UnitKilobytes. {value} is a number such as 64.6.

data.name: Core_UnitGigabytes
data.comment: A size in gigabytes, as Core_UnitKilobytes. {value} is a number such as 1.2.

data.name: Core_UnitTerabytes
data.comment: A size in terabytes, as Core_UnitKilobytes. {value} is a number such as 1.2.

data.name: Core_UnitPetabytes
data.comment: A size in petabytes, as Core_UnitKilobytes. {value} is a number such as 1.2.
